optimizer: Adam, default betas and epsilon, no weight decay
initialization: Q,K independently sampled iid N(0,.2^2); recency raw scalar 0, all 8 arms cloned
fixed_design: Use only final labels. One stream pass, no tuning, no checkpoint selection, same old sign-task generators. Window and candidate mask unchanged. Candidate j has key from x_(j-1) or x_j. Shared Q,K,scalar across the three attention steps; exact known readout of path distribution. At evaluation deploy sequential hard argmax. For parity and majority also compute unthresholded expectation sign error as a diagnostic. Public signs are excluded from scores. Input receives no gold indices.
primary_contrast: successor minus same-position hard sign error and complete path accuracy, each seed, at 2048 and 8192, unadjusted 95% t interval for each; 10% clean hard error first-grid passage.
